problem:
(set-logic UFLIA)
(declare-fun x () Int)
(define-fun k () Int x)
(define-fun h ((x Int)) Int k)
(assert (= (h 5) x))
(assert (not (= x 5)))
(check-sat)
proof:
(assume a0 (= (h 5) x))
(assume a1 (not (= x 5)))
(step t1 (cl (= x 5)) :rule symm :premises (a0))
(step t2 (cl) :rule resolution :premises (a1 t1))
